metadata.name: plain_markets
metadata.description: Plain Markets: on-chain corporate-actions servicing engine for tokenized bonds

accounts.name: vault
docs: Paying vault [b"vault", action], owned by the action PDA. Required for paying actions,
omitted for votes.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Bond mint (burned from on redemptions).

accounts.name: holder_bond
docs: Holder's bond token account; required for redemptions.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Paying vault for this action, owned by the action PDA (created at announce).

instructions.name: initialize_instrument
docs: Create the instrument and its Token-2022 bond mint (hook + permanent delegate + metadata).

accounts.name: mint
docs: delegate and metadata extensions.

instructions.name: issue
docs: Mint bond units to a holder (primary placement).

accounts.name: allow_entry
docs: Required when the allowlist is on.

instructions.name: transfer_hook
docs: SPL transfer-hook `Execute`, invoked by Token-2022 on every bond transfer.

accounts.name: allow_entry
docs: allowlist is on.

errors.name: NotIssuer
errors.msg: Only the instrument issuer may do this

errors.name: NotPayingAgent
errors.msg: Only the paying agent or the issuer may push payments

errors.name: InvalidFrequency
errors.msg: Coupon frequency must be 1, 2, 4 or 12 payments per year

errors.name: InvalidFaceValue
errors.msg: Face value must be greater than zero

errors.name: InvalidRate
errors.msg: Coupon rate is out of range

errors.name: InvalidMaturity
errors.msg: Maturity must be after issue

errors.name: InvalidMetadata
errors.msg: Name, symbol or URI is too long or empty

errors.name: InvalidSettlementMint
errors.msg: Settlement mint is the bond mint or has fee / hook / non-transferable extensions

errors.name: InstrumentNotActive
errors.msg: Instrument is not active

errors.name: PendingActionExists
errors.msg: Another corporate action is still before its payment phase

errors.name: RedemptionInProgress
errors.msg: A redemption is in progress; no other action may run

errors.name: ActionsStillOpen
errors.msg: A redemption needs every other action to be settled first

errors.name: RegisterLocked
errors.msg: The register is locked for a corporate action; issuance is paused

errors.name: ZeroUnits
errors.msg: Units must be greater than zero

errors.name: InvalidSchedule
errors.msg: Schedule must satisfy now <= record < payment <= claim deadline

errors.name: InvalidTitle
errors.msg: Title is too long or empty

errors.name: InvalidRedeemShare
errors.msg: Redemption share must be between 1 and 9999 bps

errors.name: InvalidPrice
errors.msg: Redemption price must be between 1 and 20000 bps of face

errors.name: InvalidVoteOptions
errors.msg: Votes need 2 to 4 options of 1 to 32 bytes

errors.name: UnexpectedParameter
errors.msg: Parameter does not apply to this action kind

errors.name: LockStillRunning
errors.msg: Current ex-date lock ends before this record date; announce after it ends

errors.name: InvalidActionStatus
errors.msg: Action is not in the status this instruction requires

errors.name: WrongActionKind
errors.msg: Action kind does not support this instruction

errors.name: RecordDateNotReached
errors.msg: Record date has not been reached

errors.name: RecordWindowMissed
errors.msg: Record window passed without locking the register; cancel and re-announce

errors.name: SupplyMismatch
errors.msg: Snapshot total units do not equal the bond supply

errors.name: InvalidHolderCount
errors.msg: Holder count must be between 1 and total units

errors.name: InvalidSnapshotRoot
errors.msg: Merkle root must not be zero

errors.name: RedeemTotalOutOfBounds
errors.msg: Posted redeemed-unit total is inconsistent with per-holder rounding

errors.name: ZeroEntitlement
errors.msg: Total entitlement is zero; nothing to pay

errors.name: OverFunding
errors.msg: Funding would exceed the total entitlement

errors.name: ZeroFunding
errors.msg: Funding amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: ActionNotFunded
errors.msg: Action is not fully funded

errors.name: PaymentNotDue
errors.msg: Payment date has not been reached

errors.name: AlreadyClaimed
errors.msg: Entitlement already paid for this holder

errors.name: InvalidProof
errors.msg: Merkle proof does not match the snapshot root

errors.name: ProofTooLong
errors.msg: Merkle proof is too long

errors.name: SnapshotTotalsExceeded
errors.msg: Claim would exceed the snapshot totals

errors.name: InsufficientVaultFunds
errors.msg: Paying vault does not hold enough funds

errors.name: MissingHolderBondAccount
errors.msg: Redemption requires the holder's bond token account

errors.name: InvalidHolderBondAccount
errors.msg: Bond token account does not belong to the holder or the instrument

errors.name: InsufficientUnitsToRedeem
errors.msg: Holder no longer holds the units being redeemed

errors.name: AlreadyVoted
errors.msg: Vote already cast for this holder

errors.name: InvalidVoteChoice
errors.msg: Vote choice is out of range

errors.name: VotingClosed
errors.msg: Voting is closed

errors.name: VotingNotClosed
errors.msg: Voting is still open

errors.name: VotesAlreadyCast
errors.msg: Votes were already cast; the vote cannot be cancelled

errors.name: ClaimWindowOpen
errors.msg: Claim window is still open and entitlements are outstanding

errors.name: MissingSettlementAccounts
errors.msg: Paying vault and issuer settlement account are required

errors.name: InvalidSettlementAccount
errors.msg: Settlement token account is not the expected one

errors.name: TransferLocked
errors.msg: Bond transfers are locked between record date and payment

errors.name: DestinationNotAllowlisted
errors.msg: Destination wallet is not on the instrument allowlist

errors.name: NotTransferring
errors.msg: Hook may only run inside a Token-2022 transfer

errors.name: AllowlistEntryRequired
errors.msg: Allowlist entry required for this holder

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

fields.name: fully_funded
docs: True once funded_amount == total_entitlement (status Funded).

types.name: ActionStatus
docs: Strict lifecycle. Votes skip `Funded`: SnapshotPosted opens voting, the first ballot moves the
action to `Settling`, and `settle` after the close closes the tally.

types.name: AllowEntry
docs: Wallet allowed to receive the bond when the allowlist is on. PDA [b"allow", instrument, wallet].

fields.name: rate_bps
docs: Coupon: annual rate (0 = instrument rate). FinalRedemption: final coupon rate (0 = none).

fields.name: redeem_bps
docs: PartialRedemption only.

fields.name: price_bps
docs: Redemptions only (10_000 = par).

fields.name: options
docs: Vote only.

types.name: ClaimReceipt
docs: Proof that a holder was paid for an action. PDA [b"claim", action, holder].

types.name: CorporateAction
docs: One corporate action. PDA [b"action", instrument, id as u64 LE].

fields.name: terms_hash
docs: sha256 of the off-chain announcement document (prospectus notice, vote question, ...).

fields.name: payment_ts
docs: Payment date, or vote close for votes.

fields.name: claim_deadline
docs: After this the issuer may sweep unclaimed funds back.

fields.name: rate_bps
docs: Coupon: annual rate for this period. FinalRedemption: rate of the final coupon (0 = none).

fields.name: redeem_bps
docs: PartialRedemption: share of every holding redeemed.

fields.name: price_bps
docs: Redemptions: price in bps of face (10_000 = par).

fields.name: period
docs: Coupon period number (1-based); 0 for other kinds.

fields.name: amount_per_unit
docs: Settlement base units per unit: per held unit (Coupon, FinalRedemption) or per redeemed unit
(PartialRedemption). Fixed at announcement.

fields.name: total_redeem_units
docs: Units that will be burned in total (redemptions).

fields.name: total_entitlement
docs: Settlement owed to all holders; computed on-chain.

fields.name: prev_lock_from
docs: Lock window before this action merged into it (restored on cancel).

types.name: Instrument
docs: One tokenized bond. PDA [b"instrument", mint]. It is the bond mint's mint authority, permanent
delegate, transfer-hook authority and metadata update authority.

fields.name: mint
docs: Token-2022 bond mint, 0 decimals.

fields.name: isin
docs: ISO 6166 identifier, ASCII, zero padded (may be all zero on devnet).

fields.name: face_value
docs: Par value of one bond unit in settlement base units.

fields.name: coupon_bps
docs: Annual coupon rate in bps.

fields.name: coupon_frequency
docs: Coupon payments per year (1, 2, 4, 12).

fields.name: lock_from
docs: Ex-date lock window enforced by the transfer hook: transfers fail while
lock_from <= now < lock_until.

fields.name: issued_units
docs: Units ever minted.

fields.name: redeemed_units
docs: Units burned by redemptions.

fields.name: action_count
docs: Next action id.

fields.name: coupon_periods
docs: Coupon periods announced so far (the next coupon is period coupon_periods + 1).

fields.name: pending_action
docs: Action that has not yet reached its payment phase (Funded, or SnapshotPosted for votes).

fields.name: open_actions
docs: Actions not yet Settled or Cancelled.

fields.name: open_redemption
docs: A redemption is open: it runs alone.

fields.name: face_value
docs: Par value per unit in settlement base units.

fields.name: paying_agent
docs: Defaults to the issuer when None.

fields.name: snapshot_hash
docs: sha256 of the canonical snapshot JSON published off-chain.

fields.name: total_redeem_units
docs: PartialRedemption: sum of per-holder floor(units * redeem_bps / 10_000). Ignored otherwise.

types.name: VoteRecord
docs: A holder's ballot. PDA [b"vote", action, holder].

constants.name: EXTRA_ACCOUNT_METAS_SEED
docs: Seed fixed by the SPL transfer-hook interface for the validation account.

constants.name: MAX_PROOF_LEN
docs: Longest accepted Merkle proof (2^24 ≈ 16.7M holders).
